title: 久坐腰疼打电话约理疗师首次看诊
titleEn: Booking your first physio appointment for a sore back
scene: 周五早上，你的腰已经疼了一个多星期——平时在办公室一坐一整天，上周末又在后院搬了几袋花园土，现在弯腰穿袜子都费劲。同事推荐了附近一家理疗诊所（physio），你打电话过去约第一次看诊。前台 Jade 说话又快又随意，会问你哪里疼、多久了、有没有医生转诊、有没有私人保险 Extras，还会讲价格、取消规定和第一次来要准备什么。
你的目标：① 用简单的话说清楚哪里疼、怎么弄的、疼了多久；② 约到一个不影响上班的时间（早上上班前或周六），并问清楚费用、保险能报多少、自己要付多少；③ 听懂第一次来要带什么、穿什么、提前多久到，以及改约/取消要提前多久。

facts.v: 下周一早上 7:45，首次看诊约 45 分钟
理疗师 Tom（physio），前台 Jade 接电话
首诊 $105；Extras 当场刷 HICAPS 大约报 $60，自付约 $45
改约/取消需提前 24 小时，否则收全额

vocab.zh: 理疗师（physiotherapist 的口语）/ 去看理疗
vocab.ex: My colleague said I should see a physio about my back.

vocab.en: a sore back / lower back pain
vocab.ex: I've had a sore back for about a week and a half.

vocab.en: do my back in / put my back out
vocab.ex: I think I did my back in lifting bags of soil on the weekend.
An initial consult is forty-five minutes, and follow-ups are thirty.
Do I need a referral from my GP, or can I just book in?
I can book you in with Tom on Monday morning.
Have you got anything first thing, before work?
Saturdays are booked out for the next couple of weeks.
Bring your health fund card and we can claim on the spot.

vocab.zh: 保险报完后你自己付的差价
vocab.ex: The gap's usually around forty-five dollars.

vocab.zh: 取消费 / 提前 24 小时通知
vocab.ex: We need 24 hours' notice, otherwise there's a cancellation fee.
Any numbness or pins and needles down your legs?

listening.en: Morning, Parkside Physio, Jade speaking, how can I help?
listening.sound: Morning 前面省了 Good；Jade speaking = 我是 Jade；how can I help 连成 “how-c'n-I-help”，can 弱读成 c'n。
listening.zh: 早上好，Parkside 理疗诊所，我是 Jade，有什么可以帮你？
listening.reply: Hi, I'd like to book an appointment with a physio, please. It's my first time.

listening.en: No worries. And what's brought you in — what are we lookin' at?
listening.sound: what's brought you in = 你是因为什么来的；what are we lookin' at 连读成 “wot-a-we-lookin-at”，这里不是“看”，而是“是什么问题”。
listening.zh: 没问题。是什么情况呢——哪里不舒服？
listening.reply: It's my lower back. I think I did it in lifting heavy bags in the garden last weekend.

listening.en: Have you had any numbness or pins and needles goin' down the legs at all?
listening.sound: pins and needles 连读成 “pinz-n-needlz” = 发麻刺痛；goin' down the legs = 往腿上窜；at all 放句尾 = “有没有（哪怕一点）”。
listening.zh: 腿上有没有发麻、刺痛往下窜的感觉？
listening.reply: No, nothing like that. It's just stiff and sore, especially in the morning.

listening.en: Saturdays are chockers till mid-December, I'm afraid, but Tom's got a seven-forty-five Monday if that suits.
listening.sound: chockers = 满了；till mid-December 说得很快；seven-forty-five = 7:45；if that suits = 如果你方便的话。
listening.zh: 周六恐怕到 12 月中都约满了，不过 Tom 周一早上 7:45 有空，你看行不行。
listening.reply: Monday at seven forty-five works for me. Sorry, is that with Tom?

listening.en: It's a hundred and five for the initial; if you've got extras we'll put it through HICAPS and you'll just pay the gap — usually round forty-five.
listening.sound: the initial = initial consult 首诊；put it through HICAPS = 当场刷保险；round forty-five = 大约 45（around 吞掉 a）。
listening.zh: 首诊 105 块；你有 Extras 的话我们当场刷 HICAPS，你只付差价——一般 45 左右。
listening.reply: Great. Just to confirm, I'll pay about forty-five dollars on the day?

listening.en: Just pop on something comfy — trackies or shorts — and rock up ten minutes early to do the paperwork.
listening.sound: pop on = 穿上；comfy = comfortable 舒服的；trackies = 运动裤；rock up 连成 “ro-cup” = 到场；paperwork = 填表。
listening.zh: 穿舒服点的衣服——运动裤或短裤——提前十分钟到填一下表。
listening.reply: No worries. Can I fill in the form online before I come?

speech.topic: 坐办公室的人怎么照顾自己的腰和脖子
paragraphs: I work in an office, and most days I sit at my desk for seven or eight hours. For years I didn't think about it. Then last week I lifted some heavy bags in the garden, and the next morning I could hardly bend down to put my socks on. That was a big wake-up call for me.

I booked in to see a physio, and she told me something simple: sitting isn't the real problem — sitting still for too long is. So now I try to get up every thirty or forty minutes. I fill up my water bottle, walk to the printer, or take phone calls standing up. It sounds small, but it really adds up.

I've also changed my desk set-up. My screen used to be too low, so I was always looking down. Now it's at eye level, and my chair supports my lower back. At home, I do ten minutes of easy stretches before bed. Some nights I'm tired and I skip it, but most nights I get it done.

The other thing I've learned is not to ignore pain. In the past, I would just take a painkiller and keep going. Now, if something hurts for more than a few days, I get it checked. Physio isn't cheap, but my extras cover a good part of it, so it's worth using.
If you work in an office like me, my advice is: move a little, often. Your back will thank you.
speech.zh: 我在办公室上班，每天坐七八个小时，以前从没在意。上周在花园搬了重袋子，第二天连弯腰穿袜子都难，这让我警醒了。理疗师告诉我：问题不在坐，而在一动不动坐太久。所以我现在每三四十分钟起来一次——接水、去打印机、站着接电话，小事累积起来作用很大。我也调整了办公桌：屏幕抬到视线高度，椅子能托住腰；晚上睡前做十分钟拉伸。我还学会了不忽视疼痛——疼了好几天就去看，理疗不便宜，但 Extras 能报不少，值得用。我的建议：经常动一动，腰会感谢你。

patterns.en: That was a big wake-up call for me — I ___.
patterns.zh: 那件事让我警醒了——（之后我做了什么）

patterns.en: It sounds small, but it really adds up.
patterns.zh: 听起来是小事，但积累起来作用很大

patterns.en: If something ___ for more than a few days, I ___.

lines.en: Morning, Parkside Physio, Jade speaking, how can I help?
lines.zh: 早上好，Parkside 理疗诊所，我是 Jade，有什么可以帮你？

lines.en: Hi Jade. I'd like to book an appointment with a physio, please. It's my first time with you.
lines.zh: 你好 Jade。我想约一次理疗，我是第一次来你们这儿。

lines.en: Lovely, no worries. And what's brought you in — what are we lookin' at?
lines.zh: 好的，没问题。是什么情况呢——哪里不舒服？

lines.en: It's my lower back. I sit at a desk all day, and last weekend I lifted some heavy bags of soil in the garden. I think I did my back in.
lines.zh: 是腰（下背部）。我整天坐办公室，上周末又在花园搬了几袋很重的土，我觉得把腰弄伤了。

lines.en: Oh, ouch. Yeah, we see a lot of that this time of year — everyone's out in the garden. How long's it been sore for?
lines.zh: 哎呀。嗯，每年这个时候这种情况很多——大家都在弄花园。疼了多久了？

lines.en: About a week and a half. It's stiff in the morning, and it hurts when I bend down.
lines.zh: 大概一个半星期。早上很僵，弯腰的时候疼。

lines.en: Righto. Have you had any numbness or pins and needles goin' down the legs at all?
lines.zh: 好。腿上有没有发麻、刺痛往下窜的感觉？

lines.en: Sorry, could you say that again a bit slower? Pins and…?
lines.zh: 不好意思，能说慢一点再说一遍吗？Pins and……？

lines.en: Sure — pins and needles. Like a tingly feeling, or your legs going numb.
lines.zh: 好的——pins and needles，就是那种发麻刺痛的感觉，或者腿发麻没知觉。

lines.en: Oh, I see. No, nothing like that. It's just sore.
lines.zh: 哦，明白了。没有，没有那种感觉，就是疼。

lines.en: Good, good. If that does start happening, see your GP straight away, okay? Now, did a doctor refer you, or are you just booking in yourself?
lines.zh: 好的。如果开始出现那种情况，马上去看你的 GP，好吗？那么，是医生转诊过来的，还是你自己预约？

lines.en: Just myself. Do I need a referral?
lines.zh: 我自己约的。需要转诊信吗？

lines.en: Nah, you don't need one for physio. Are you after a particular day? We've got early mornings and some Saturdays.
lines.zh: 不用，看理疗不需要。你想约哪天？我们有一大早的时段，也有一些周六。

lines.en: Something before work would be best. Or a Saturday morning, if you have one.
lines.zh: 最好是上班前的时间。或者周六上午，如果有的话。

lines.en: Saturdays are chockers till mid-December, I'm afraid, but Tom's got a seven-forty-five Monday if that suits. Initial consult's forty-five minutes, so you'd be out by half eight.
lines.zh: 周六恐怕到 12 月中都约满了，不过 Tom 周一早上 7:45 有空，你看行不行。首诊 45 分钟，八点半就能结束。

lines.en: Just to confirm, that's this Monday, the thirtieth, at seven forty-five?
lines.zh: 确认一下，是这周一，30 号，7:45？

lines.en: Yep, Monday the thirtieth. Can I grab your name and date of birth?
lines.zh: 对，周一 30 号。请告诉我你的名字和出生日期。

lines.en: It's Amy Zhang — Z-H-A-N-G. Date of birth is the fourteenth of March, 1988. And my mobile is 0491 570 236.
lines.zh: Amy Zhang——Z-H-A-N-G。出生日期是 1988 年 3 月 14 日。我的手机是 0491 570 236。

lines.en: Perfect, you're all booked in. Do you have private health with extras?
lines.zh: 好，给你约上了。你有带 Extras 的私人保险吗？

lines.en: Yes, I do. How much is the appointment, and how much will I get back?
lines.zh: 有。看一次多少钱？能报多少？

lines.en: It's a hundred and five for the initial. Bring your card and we'll put it through HICAPS on the spot, so you just pay the gap — usually round forty-five, but it depends on your fund and your level of cover.
lines.zh: 首诊 105 块。带上保险卡，我们当场刷 HICAPS，你只付差价——一般 45 左右，不过要看你的保险公司和保障级别。

lines.en: Okay, great. Is there anything I should bring or wear?
lines.zh: 好的。我需要带什么或者穿什么吗？

lines.en: Just pop on something comfy — trackies or shorts — so Tom can have a proper look. And if you've had any scans or X-rays, bring 'em along. Oh, and rock up ten minutes early to do the paperwork, or I can flick you a link to fill it in online.
lines.zh: 穿舒服点的——运动裤或短裤——方便 Tom 好好检查。如果拍过片子或 X 光，也带上。哦，还有提前十分钟到填表，或者我可以发个链接给你在网上填。

lines.en: The link would be great, thanks. And if I need to change the time, how much notice do you need?
lines.zh: 发链接最好，谢谢。如果我要改时间，需要提前多久说？

lines.en: We need twenty-four hours' notice, otherwise we charge the full fee, unfortunately. You'll get a reminder text the day before — just reply Y to confirm.
lines.zh: 需要提前 24 小时通知，不然很遗憾要收全额。前一天你会收到提醒短信——回复 Y 确认就行。

lines.en: Got it. Thanks so much, Jade. See you Monday — and I'll try not to lift anything heavy this weekend!
lines.zh: 明白了。非常感谢，Jade。周一见——这个周末我尽量不搬重东西了！

rescue.en: Sorry, could you say that again a bit slower?
rescue.zh: 不好意思，能说慢一点再说一遍吗？

rescue.en: Sorry, what does "pins and needles" mean?
rescue.zh: 不好意思，“pins and needles” 是什么意思？

rescue.en: Just to confirm, that's Monday the thirtieth at seven forty-five?
rescue.zh: 确认一下，是 30 号周一 7:45 对吗？

rescue.en: Sorry, how much did you say the gap is?
rescue.zh: 不好意思，你说差价是多少？

rescue.en: Could you text me the time and the address, please?
rescue.zh: 能把时间和地址发短信给我吗？

checklist: 我能用两三句话说清楚哪里疼、怎么弄伤的、疼了多久
我听懂了 what are we lookin' at、pins and needles 是在问什么
我知道看理疗不需要 GP 转诊信，能主动问 Do I need a referral?
我能说出想要的时间（first thing / before work / Saturday），并复述确认日期和时间
我听懂了 initial consult $105、put it through HICAPS、pay the gap 的意思
我知道要穿 trackies 或短裤、提前十分钟到、取消要提前 24 小时
